title: Rubric Rater — Score This Expression
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Given a rendered face and its underlying face_state parameters, assess it against each criterion of the Emotional Design Rubric, assigning a rating per criterion with a written justification and an overall recommendation — directly rehearsing the course's Evaluate-level outcome of critiquing a classmate's design.
